recognition: Self-governing state in free association with New Zealand.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
rulers: King CHARLES III (since 8 September 2022); represented by Sir Tom J. MARSTERS (since 9 August 2013); New Zealand High Commissioner Catherine GRAHAM (since 8 September 2024); Prime Minister Mark BROWN (since 1 October 2020)
economy: high-income self-governing New Zealand territorial economy; tourism-based activity but diversifying; severely curtailed by COVID-19 pandemic; copra and tropical fruit exporter; Asian Development Bank aid recipient GDP (PPP): $401.155 million (2024 est.). note: data are in 2015 dollars
military: no regular military forces; Cook Islands Police Service
origin: 4 August 1965 (Cook Islands became self-governing state in free association with New Zealand)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
